p: Clifton is one of Nottingham's biggest estates, and Southchurch Drive is its everyday high street: bakers, takeaways, a pharmacy and local shops all clustered together, so this is very much a neighbourhood venue rather than a destination in its own right.

The big plus is the tram. Nottingham's NET trams run all the way out to Clifton South, which means the city centre, the Old Market Square and all its bars and arcades are an easy ride away without touching the car. Nottingham Trent University has its Clifton campus nearby too, so the area always has a bit of life about it. Admiral is strictly for adults, 18 and over, so it suits a quiet half hour rather than a family outing.
